test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

His gold ornaments were stolen by a thief.

options.text: A thief stole his gold ornaments.
A thief had stolen his gold ornaments.
A thief has stolen his gold ornaments.
A thief have stolen his gold ornaments

solution:
The correct answer is: **A thief stole his gold ornaments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, the subject is acted upon by the verb (passive voice), and the thief is the agent performing the action.
 
 
• **Passive Voice Structure**: Subject (His gold ornaments) + Verb (were stolen) + Agent (by a thief).__

 __
 
• **Example**: *The cake was eaten by John.*
 
 
 
 
 
• In the active voice, the subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• This structure makes the sentence clearer and more direct compared to the passive voice, where the subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
 
• **Active Voice Structure**: Agent (A thief) + Verb (stole) + Object (his gold ornaments).__
 
 
• **Example**: *John ate the cake.*
 
 
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
